sentences.en: The smallest species of otter is the Asian small-clawed otter.
sentences.zh: 最小的一种水獭是亚洲小爪水獭。

sentences.en: The otter features in mythology and folklore across the world.
sentences.zh: 水獭在世界各地的神话和民间传说中都有出现。

sentences.en: Sea otters love to eat clams while swimming on their backs.
sentences.zh: 海獭喜欢边仰泳边吃蛤蜊。

phrases.zh: 海獭：喜欢浮在水面休息或觅食的水獭品种。
